/benchmarks.alt: Pyreon benchmarks: 2.6× faster than React 19 creating 10,000 rows; 4× less JavaScript than React 19 for the same app; 6.5× faster server rendering than React 19 at 1,000 rows; 8.7× faster than ECharts 6 mounting a 100,000-point line chart. Synthetic, author-run.

/brand.alt: Pyreon Brand: The Pyreon mark, colours and type, and the few rules that keep them meaning something.

/community.alt: Pyreon Community: Pyreon is built in the open under the MIT license.

/compare/next.alt: Pyreon Zero vs Next.js: File routes, SSR, SSG and ISR. On components that run once.

/compare/react-native.alt: Pyreon Native vs React Native: One .tsx. A website, an iPhone app and an Android app.

/compare/react.alt: Pyreon vs React: React ships 4× more JavaScript for the same app. 4× less JavaScript: 17.2 KB against React's 69.6 KB for the same keyed-table app (gzip)

/compare/solid.alt: Pyreon vs Solid: Same signals as Solid. renderToString up to 4.7× faster. 4.68× faster renderToString on a card component: 8.95M against 1.91M renders a second, byte-identical HTML enforced

/compare/svelte.alt: Pyreon vs Svelte: 2,047 components. Mounted 3× faster than Svelte 5. 3.0× faster to mount a 2,047-component tree: 3.59 ms against 10.80 ms

/compare/vue.alt: Pyreon vs Vue: Vue's reactivity without .value. In 1.6× less JavaScript. 1.6× less JavaScript: 17.2 KB against Vue's 27.4 KB for the same keyed-table app (gzip)

/migrate.alt: Migrate to Pyreon: Bring your React app. Keep shipping while you move.

/migrate/preact.alt: Migrate from Preact with @pyreon/preact-compat: Preact code, hooks and signals included.

/migrate/react.alt: Migrate from React with @pyreon/react-compat: Your React code, on Pyreon's engine.

/migrate/solid.alt: Migrate from Solid with @pyreon/solid-compat: Your Solid components run on day one.

/migrate/svelte.alt: Migrate from Svelte with @pyreon/svelte-compat: Keep your stores. Move components to TSX.

/migrate/vue.alt: Migrate from Vue with @pyreon/vue-compat: Keep your composables. Port templates when you're ready.

/releases.alt: Pyreon Releases: Every merged change that affects users carries a changeset.

/why/ai-ready.alt: Your AI writes a bug. Pyreon catches it. An MCP server with 24 tools, live/static hints in your editor, pyreon check and llms.txt. No network calls.

/why/components-run-once.alt: Your component runs once. Ever. Delete useMemo, useCallback and every dependency array. 2.6× faster than React at 10,000 rows (synthetic, author-run).

/why/full-stack.alt: SSG, SSR, ISR or SPA. Per route, in one line. Pyreon Zero: per-route render modes, hydration that keeps what users typed, and SSR 6.5× faster than React 19 (one run).

/why/one-codebase.alt: One .tsx file. Three apps. A website, real SwiftUI and real Jetpack Compose from the same component. Experimental, device-tested in CI.

/why/performance.alt: 2.6× faster than React. Don't trust us. Run it. Ten frameworks, real Chromium, one command to reproduce. Synthetic, author-run, M3 Max.
